items.text: We want to let you know about an important update.

A recently identified security vulnerability within Unity has been spotted, and while there is currently no evidence of impact on users, we’re taking all relevant steps to ensure you’re on the latest and safest version of the game.
To keep you safe, we’ve released a new patch that addresses the issue. Please update your game as soon as possible to stay protected.

notes.title: You can read more about it here

items.text: As always, our priority will be on keeping our games safe and enjoyable for everyone.

items.text: We’ve heard you (Just as you heard Jack sighing)! We’re introducing the Cheer-Up-Date for Autopsy Simulator. This update brings changes to Jack’s voice lines, removing some of his sighing during Dead Memories Story Mode and making overall improvements to his voice lines.

Alongside changes to Jack’s voice lines, the Cheer-Up-Date brings multiple improvements to existing features and further bug fixes across both Autopsy Simulator game modes- Dead Memories Story Mode & Autopsy Only Mode.
We hope you've kept your scalpels sharp and enjoy the new free update from Autopsy Simulator on Steam! 🔪
Improvements to Jack Hanman’s voice lines throughout Autopsy Simulator, removing the number of sighs throughout Dead Memories Story Mode.
Increased Jack’s audio levels Chapter 5 to ensure all voice lines can be heard correctly.
Improvements to controller support, including:
Players can now switch between Controller and Mouse & Keyboard more conveniently.
Improvements to button remapping/rebinding.
Improvements to the file save slots to improve their stability.
Improvements to UV light during external inspections.

notes.title: Autopsy Only Mode is OUT NOW! 💉

items.text: Hey Pathologists! 👋 Today we've released a free simulation-focused content update, which brings the arrival of Autopsy Only Mode to Autopsy Simulator. Ready to test your skills in the Autopsy Room?

🧑‍⚕️ Simulation gameplay focus: Step into the shoes of a student pathologist and conduct autopsies correctly by following the accurate flow and procedures in the Autopsy Room to get the best final rating and score!

🔁 Follow the correct autopsy flow: Ensure all areas of the internal and external examinations are conducted and performed well. If some procedures during the autopsy are skipped, players will be docked points from their final score.
🤔 Final cause of death judgement: In Autopsy Only Mode, there are seven generic causes of death across all cadavers and three unique causes of death, one per cadaver in Autopsy Only Mode.
When you begin your game of AOM, there are eight possible causes of death for each body. Select the correct cause of death for the cadaver to gain points and a better final rank in Autopsy Only Mode!

We've also added fourteen decoy causes of death, to add more randomness to the game mode and increase replayability! Decoy causes of death create misdirection, whilst developing the narrative of the events unfolding as you progress through the autopsy.

💯 Get scored on your autopsy performance: In Autopsy Only Mode, you'll be scored on several criteria, including Minigame Score, Planning & Preparations, Unnecessary Examinations, Final Cause of Death, and Clean Up.

All choices during the new game mode will affect your final score, so make sure you're making decisive decisions in the Autopsy Room to ensure the best Autopsy Only Mode score. Make sure to photograph every integral area of the cadaver, only dissect organs crucial to the case files, and of course... remember to put your medical gloves on! 🧤
Alongside this, ensure you are cutting organs correctly and not failing any minigames, as this will cause you to lose score.

Our free update for Autopsy Simulator also contains improvements and tweaks to our Dead Memories story mode! The changes in this patch have come from your Dead Memories launch feedback and include improvements to the scare trigger points to make scares easier to experience, improved flow throughout Dead Memories by holding players during conversations with NPCs that include important plot points, tweaks to the secret ending to make this easier to trigger, and more!
Find out more about our new game mode addition in Autopsy Only Mode and our changes to Dead Memories in our full patch notes: ⬇️
Additions
New Simulation Game Mode Added - Autopsy Only Mode

Our Simulation Focused game mode is now out for Autopsy Simulator: Become a student pathologist, conducting autopsies on three varied bodies, with eight causes of death in total per autopsy and three unique causes of death across the game mode, one unique per body.
Additions to Autopsy Only Mode since PTE Update 3:
Third cadaver body type added to Autopsy Only Mode.
New and improved cadaver injuries and textures in Autopsy Only Mode.
11 achievements added to Autopsy Simulator, all unlocked in Autopsy Only Mode.
Improvements
Improvements made to localisation in Autopsy Only Mode.
Improvements made to controller support in Autopsy Only Mode.
Additions
Players are now held throughout Dead Memories story mode during conversations with NPCs and dialogue lines, ensuring no story points are missed.
Fixes
Fixed issues around the secret ending of Dead Memories, making the second ending easier to trigger.
Fixed an issue where censoring would occasionally not appear for female cadavers in the Autopsy Room for Dead Memories.
Improvements
Improvements to scare trigger points throughout Dead Memories to make specific scares easier to trigger and experience.
Improvements made to the smash the lock mini game in Dead Memories.
Improvements made to the audio mix of Dead Memories, including tweaks to specific dialogue lines to make dialogue easier to hear and understand.
Overall improvements to censoring setting in Dead Memories.
Additional improvements made to the overall story mode game flow, including improvements to the ending sequence of Dead Memories.

How's it going Pathologists? We've just rolled out the second update for our PTE branch build for Autopsy Only Mode. This update for the AOM PTE adds a new female cadaver, adds tutorial VOs, improves the lighting, and much more!
Find all the details of what's new for this PTE update in our Patch Notes below! 👇
New Female cadaver added
Added a blackboard with average organ size and length
The liver has a new maze in cutting minigame
Tutorial VOs added
VOs can be switched on/off using in-game tape recorder
Localisation for all supported languages have been added
Added organ information to clipboard
Updated Organ and Injury Textures on cadavers
Blackboard showcasing the autopsy loop has been polished
Lightning has been polished
Muting sound/music now works correctly
Minor balance changes
Fixed - Microscope locks the game after finishing the blood test and quickly interacting with another item
Fixed - Unable to back out of the Microscope game on occasion causing the title to soft lock
Fixed - Players not being able to highlight wounds on the clipboard
Fixed - The sound of writing persists and it's looped when the player exits to the main menu
Fixed - Part of the female cadaver’s body's lungs sticks out of the cadaver
Fixed - Marks that were photographed are not circled when using the magnifier
Fixed - Lighting from the lamps illuminate under the desk area rather than on it
Fixed - Some bodies have mismatched gender on the clipboard
Fixed - Censorship mode on the female cadavers
Fixed - Female cadavers marks being placed in places outside its body
Fixed - Issue that caused the brain to clip outside of cadaver’s heads
Fixed - Clicking "play again" after finishing an autopsy in Autopsy Only Mode that moved the player to story mode
Fixed - Soft lock in the pipette mini game screen after interacting with it
Fixed - issue where the music in the title would not play
Fixed - Taking a photo of a mark on a cadaver after highlighting it with a magnifier (but not investigating) causes a soft lock
Fixed - Picking up the liver triggers incorrect VO
Fixed - The corridors floor in Autopsy Only Mode has no textures

NOTE: Our PTE is currently in English Only. We'll be looking to add more languages soon, but as this is a pre-alpha build the game mode is in English only. AOM will feature more languages in full release!

Although we've fixed a number of bugs found in our previous playtest, the PTE build remains a pre-alpha meaning you'll likely run into issues throughout your playthrough. Our Known Issues list is below:
Issue: Cut organ minigame soft locks the game if failed and pass successfully at the same time in Autopsy only mode. Failing near finish of the maze can make this happen.
Issue: Changing the Action button in the Controls menu makes neither LMB nor the new button working in menus (Autopsy Only Mode).
Issue: Changing the language in Main Menu - Settings results in buttons being unresponsive.
Issue: Alligator bite minigame can be done after guessing cause of death in Autopsy only mode.
Issue: Rebinding movement buttons does not change in-game movement.
Issue: Button prompts can be visible and do not change while changing controls in Autopsy Only Mode.
Issue: The knife in the animation slices through the stomach before the player ends the stomach slicing minigame in Autopsy Only Mode.
Issue: "Bruises on head" can be photographed and pinned to the magnetic board before the General Photo.
Issue: Incorrect button prompts are displayed during alligator bite minigame in Autopsy Only Mode.
Issue: The Facial Edema mark on the female body's face doesn't cover the whole nose.
Issue: Player model's legs have no movement animation when looked at in camera mode.
Issue: Sometimes the clipboard noting information about one of the brain types does not appear in Autopsy Only Mode.
Issue: Some organs do not have physics enabled during a visual inspection in Autopsy Only Mode.
Issue: Scalpel is clipping with the body around collarbones and the head when holding the LMB during use.
Issue: Marks on the right hand do not move along with it during the Rigor Mortis.
Issue: The legs are clipping through the apron during movement.
Issue: After cutting the top of the body's head, the area where it was before is still marked as an interactive zone in Autopsy Only Mode.
Issue: Drawing blood with censorship on results in one of the censorship pixels being coloured red in Autopsy Only Mode.
Issue: Organic fluid string inside the chest beneath skin flap has no animation in Autopsy Only Mode.
Issue: Shadow resolution cannot be changed in graphic settings.

Have some feedback or ran into an issue in the PTE? Let us know in our Autopsy Discord server. We're also looking for specific feedback around the simulation gameplay, AOM's game-loop and scoring system, so we can collate your feedback and use this to create the best PTE possible!

To join the PTE, head to the BETA tab in the properties of Autopsy Simulator in your Steam Library. Once here, select the 'None' drop down and an option named 'Autopsy_only_preview' will appear. Select this option from the drop-down and opt-into the AOM PTE branch!

notes.title: Here are the full steps to access the AOM PTE

items.text: Go to your Steam Library
Right Click on Autopsy Simulator
Click on Properties
Select the BETAS tab on the left
Select the 'None' drop down in the top right of the Beta menu.
Select 'Autopsy_only_preview' in the drop down menu.
Click on "Opt-into: Autopsy_only_preview"
Autopsy Simulator should now be downloading an update for Autopsy Only Mode! If not, simply quit and restart Steam.

items.text: Hey Pathologists, we've just rolled out an update for our PTE branch build for Autopsy Only Mode. Our first update for the AOM PTE adds a new Loppers minigame, fixes a bug around missing translation strings, adds improvements to the scoring and hint systems in Autopsy Only Mode, and more.
Find all the details of what's new for this PTE update in our Patch Notes below! 👇
Addition of the Loppers Minigame for removing the rib cage.
Addition of placeholder textures for specific conditions and wound graphics which now replace missing art assets in Autopsy Only Mode, to remove some ‘X mark’ placeholders for assets.
Examinations now have full descriptions, instead of single words for their examination descriptions.
Addition of randomized facial hair style and head design for the cadaver.
Additional sequence added to Autopsy Only Mode at the end of the Autopsy, where the player puts the body inside the fridge to close out the examination.
Walkman is now added as an intractable object.
Players can now interact with the in-game radio, which plays the main theme of Autopsy Simulator.
Fixed a bug around missing translations strings found in documents throughout Autopsy Only Mode.
Blood tests are now fully functional in Autopsy Only Mode.
Player now has to take photos and use the magnifier tool to inspect the cadaver before opening the body.
Overall improvements to the hint systems in Autopsy Only Mode.
Specific tweaks to the scoring system in Autopsy Only Mode.
Added some music and sound effects to Autopsy Only Mode.

NOTE: Our PTE is currently in English Only. We'll be looking to add more languages soon, but as this is a pre-alpha build the game mode is in English only. AOM will feature more languages in full release!

Although we've fixed a number of bugs found in our previous playtest, the PTE build remains a pre-alpha meaning you'll likely run into issues throughout your playthrough. Our Known Issues list is below:
Issue: Changing the Action button in the Controls menu makes neither LMB nor the new button working in menus for Autopsy Only Mode.
What to do: Avoid changing the action button. Our settings are a work in progress for this build, so this functionality is not yet finalized.
Issue: After finishing a blood test, if you quickly interact with another object or pull away from the blood test the game can softlock.

What to do: When finishing blood test with microscope, avoid quickly pressing the left mouse button. The cursor icon can be visible and still cause a softlock, so wait until your character's point of view has returned before left clicking.
Issue: The pipette screen can occasionally softlock.
What to do: The pipette may stay in the players control after completing the mini game, which blocks moving on. If happens it should be safe to restart the game mode.
Issue: Checking blood under a microscope occasionally softlocks the game.
What to do: If the blood under the microscope freezes, try to exit with right mouse button. If this continues, restart via the pause menu.
Issue: Putting on gloves and aprons on at the end of an autopsy may cause players to revive points towards their final score. This is a current error and does not impact gameplay.
Issue: Players are unable to highlight wounds on the clipboard in Autopsy Only Mode. The Clipboard is not finalized yet and is a work in progress.
Issue: Whilst remapped to a different button, the tab button will open but not close.
What to do: Avoid button remapping. Our settings are a work in progress at this stage of development.

Issue: Settings control options can be inconsistent in Autopsy Only Mode. Our current settings menus are still a work in progress for AOM and will be finalized for future builds/for the full launch of Autopsy Only Mode.
Issue: Button prompts do not change when button remapping in Autopsy Only Mode and can display the wrong buttons when changing controls.
What to do: Avoid button remapping. Our settings are a work in progress at this stage of development.
Issue: The controls menu and options inside this menu react with a delay in Autopsy Only Mode. These settings are a work in progress and will be updated soon.
Issue: Entering the Pause Menu and pressing Back while interacting with the cadaver makes parts of the interface disappear.
What to do: Re-entering the Pause Menu brings the UI back.
Issue: Some sound effects are missing from Autopsy Only Mode, as sound effects are still a work in progress for the game mode.
Issue: After cutting the top of the cadaver’s head, the area can remain marked as an interactive zone when this action is complete. This is a visual issue and has no impact on gameplay.
Issue: If you turn censorship on and draw blood from the cadaver, it results in one pixel being coloured red in Autopsy Only Mode. This issue has no impact on gameplay.
Issue: The incorrect voice-over is triggered when picking up the liver in Autopsy Only Mode. Our sound effects are not yet finalised for Autopsy Only Mode.
Issue: When opening up the chest of the cadaver, there’s currently no animation for the stringed fluid beneath the chest. This is a visual issue only.
Issue: Shadow resolution cannot be changed in the graphics settings menu in Autopsy Only Mode. Our settings are still a work in progress and will be finalised later for Autopsy Only Mode.

Issue: A ‘Skip’ prompt will appear in the lower right corner whilst some voiceover lines are active, which currently is unusable. This is a work in progress and this button is currently a visual placeholder. It will function in the final version/future builds of Autopsy Only Mode.

Issue: The page for marking and noting wounds on organ’s can sometimes be incorrect, marking on the main page instead in Autopsy Only Mode. The clipboard is a work in progress and its functionality is not yet final.
Issue: Music is not present in Autopsy Only Mode. Our music and sound effects are not yet finalised for Autopsy Only Mode’s PTE.

Have some feedback or ran into an issue in the PTE? Let us know in our Autopsy Discord server. We're also looking for specific feedback around the simulation gameplay, AOM's game-loop and scoring system, so we can collate your feedback and use this to create the best PTE possible!

To join the PTE, head to the BETA tab in the properties of Autopsy Simulator in your Steam Library. Once here, select the 'None' drop down and an option named 'Autopsy_only_preview' will appear. Select this option from the drop-down and opt-into the AOM PTE branch!
